statement: For any one actual representative of each of the three pants section classes of D74, the full compact F2[[E]] augmentation module of their three coset spaces is projective and isomorphic to F2[[E]] squared. The proof gives the actual index-two coefficient sequence, the cup-u degree-one surjection, finite-coefficient relative Ext vanishing, finite module splittings and a compatible inverse limit of finite free-module isomorphisms. The specified two-column incidence map has cokernel exactly the augmentation kernel of F2[[E/H]], where H is the closed subgroup generated by the three chosen involutions; it is invertible exactly when H=E. Four literal involutions already generate E, with one duplicated section class and the unique D74 transporter explicitly retained.
depends_on: D34 actual normalized pants extension and three section classes; D74 full self-centralizers and unique coboundary; full free profinite universal property and actual index-two coefficient induction/coinduction maps; A-KochloukovaZalesskii2007 Theorem 2 and Section 1.1 in degree two for arbitrary finite F2 modules; C-WilkesRelativeAccepted2018 Section 1 and Definition 2.1 for compact/discrete Hom and the actual augmentation relative theory; all finite projectivity, semisimple-top, inverse-limit and incidence comparisons proved in the text
manuscript_passages: Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Section 31, folios 198-199 verso, scans 391-394; Section 24, folio 147 verso, scan 293; Part D(b), the full loop-outer finite-action and actual peripheral-recognition problem for type (0,3)
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. Every coset restriction, coefficient injection and augmentation, induction/coinduction comparison, connecting cochain, finite coinvariant and incidence quotient retains the actual E, F, quotient character and chosen section subgroups. The relative projectivity step is proved directly from Brown restriction and the index-two coefficient exact sequence, without a stronger interpretation of Haran's embedding-problem convention.
computational_checks: No computational claim. The module identities and finite-quotient arguments hold for every indicated finite coefficient module and quotient; their universal formulas are proved explicitly. No finite sample is used to infer full group generation or a coproduct presentation.
notes: The finite isomorphism sets need not have onto transition maps; their finite intersection property is obtained from common finer quotients. The module isomorphism is not substituted for the specified incidence map. The chosen triple s, xs, h y h^-1 s generates exactly K semidirect C2 with K the closed subgroup generated by x and h y h^-1. Generation of this K as the full free group, the third-cusp conjugacy equation and exhaustion of the full pure pants involution orbit remain unproved.
